Internal Committee (IC) Member Certification Program

The definitive certification program for Internal Committee members under the POSH Act. Combines legal knowledge with practical inquiry skills to ensure your IC operates with confidence, fairness, and full statutory compliance.

Duration

8 hours

Format

Live Virtual

Certification

Included

Participants

Up to 25

This program is available for group delivery at your organization. Pricing is per-cohort, not per-head — making it cost-effective for teams of all sizes.

No commitment required. We'll discuss your requirements first.

Course Curriculum

8 modules · 8 hours total · Certification upon completion

01

Legal Framework & Legislative History

45 min

The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013 — legislative intent, key definitions, scope of application, and employer obligations.

02

Identifying Sexual Harassment

60 min

Distinguishing between quid pro quo and hostile work environment harassment. Case studies and scenario analysis from Indian jurisprudence.

03

Role & Responsibilities of the IC

90 min

Composition requirements, quorum, powers, and the IC's duties throughout the complaint lifecycle — from receipt to resolution.

04

Inquiry Procedure & Natural Justice

90 min

Step-by-step inquiry conduct: receiving complaints, preliminary assessment, inquiry hearings, evidence examination, and maintaining confidentiality.

05

Inquiry Report & Recommendations

60 min

Drafting findings, formulating recommendations, and communicating the report to management and parties — practical templates included.

06

Conciliation & Settlement

45 min

When and how conciliation applies, how to facilitate it ethically, and documenting the outcome within POSH Act parameters.

07

Annual Reporting & Recordkeeping

30 min

Statutory annual reporting obligations, POSH register maintenance, and proactive compliance measures to avoid penalties.

08

Mock Inquiry Exercise

60 min

Participants conduct a simulated inquiry using a realistic case scenario — applying all prior learning in a structured debrief session.

Newly appointed IC members
Existing IC members seeking certification
